The file is saved unencrypted where you choose and contains the raw records: apps, hosts, addresses, times, DNS lookups, permission use and — if decryption (research build) was on — the content of requests and responses.
That content can include things other people sent you or that were sent about them: their messages, names, photos, locations and account details. They have not agreed to this. Keep the file private, do not upload or share it, and delete it when you no longer need it.

This unencrypted file includes package names and signer fingerprints. Host/IP targets are redacted by default, making those rules incomplete on restore. Choose a destination; a cloud document provider may upload your file. Session rules, history, consents and secrets are excluded.

Only supported exact blocking rules are accepted. Existing IDs and revisions are kept. New rules map to this Android profile and remain inactive until individual review and fresh consent. No VPN starts. Missing identities, signer mismatches and redacted targets cannot activate. Disabled rules remain disabled.

Confirm this exact app, target and signing identity. Activation requires the installed app to have the same signer and a single-package UID in this profile. This records fresh consent. Enabled rules apply when WAYD runs; disabled rules stay disabled. A whole-app target blocks all supported connections. Remove any unwanted rule in Controls.
Review failed. The app is missing, its identity differs, the target is incomplete, or policy activation failed. The rule remains unreviewed.

Optional Mihomo v1.19.33 routing for explicitly selected apps. Initial Clash subset: SOCKS5 / HTTP CONNECT, static select groups (first entry), PROCESS-NAME, DOMAIN, DOMAIN-SUFFIX, IP-CIDR / IP-CIDR6 and MATCH. Proxy server addresses must be numeric IPs. Unsupported options are rejected. WAYD blocks always win; proxy failure never falls back to Direct.

DNS stays on the underlying network unless an attributable selected flow is explicitly routed. No fake IP, encrypted DNS or DNS leak protection. Unknown/shared-UID and unselected apps use Direct. IPv6 follows WAYD’s existing coverage. No subscriptions, health probes or automatic downloads.
Stop WAYD before changing routing. Start it again to apply. Profile changes do not enable traffic recording.
Routing operation failed. Check supported options and app identities. Invalid enabled profiles prevent VPN startup. Delete a damaged profile to recover.
